decls.name: --ui-rte-block-margin-inline
decls.selector: .markdown-editor-react__richtext-content .ProseMirror > :is(p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)

decls.name: --ui-rte-block-padding-inline
decls.selector: .markdown-editor-react__richtext-content .ProseMirror > :is(p, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6)

decls.name: --glass-island-background
decls.condition: @layer properties && ((-webkit-hyphens:none) and (not (margin-trim:inline))) or ((-moz-orient:inline) and (not (color:rgb(from red r g b))))

decls.name: --glass-island-border-color

decls.name: --cursor-font-family-mono

html.--cursor-box-shadow-lg: inset 0px 0px 4px 0px #FFFFFF0D, 0px 0px 3px 0px color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, #000000 20%, transparent) 60%, transparent), 0px 16px 24px 0px color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, #000000 20%, transparent) 30%, transparent)

html.--cursor-box-shadow-soft: 0px 0px 8px 2px color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, #000000 20%, transparent) 30%, transparent)
html.--cursor-box-shadow-xl: inset 0px 0px 4px 0px #FFFFFF0D, 0px 0px 6px 8px color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, #000000 20%, transparent) 60%, transparent), 0px 24px 16px 6px color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, #000000 20%, transparent) 30%, transparent)
html.--cursor-font-family-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
